claim: Constructed global rectangle primitive and bounded-derivative uniform closure extension, independent of Riemann mapping and without assumed boundary values.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.required_input: Construct primitives on actual complex open rectangles.
obligations.constructed_input: The function is complex differentiable on Ioo(a,b)×Ioo(c,d). Its primitive is the actual two-segment wedge integral imported from pinned mathlib HasPrimitives, not a supplied primitive or formal symbol.
obligations.justification: The function is complex differentiable on Ioo(a,b)×Ioo(c,d). Its primitive is the actual two-segment wedge integral imported from pinned mathlib HasPrimitives, not a supplied primitive or formal symbol.

obligations.name: Indices
obligations.required_input: Cover all points and all intermediate horizontal/vertical segments.
obligations.constructed_input: Every interval integral between coordinate endpoints inside the open rectangle is integrable by continuity and exact coordinate interval containment, regardless of endpoint orientation.
obligations.justification: Every interval integral between coordinate endpoints inside the open rectangle is integrable by continuity and exact coordinate interval containment, regardless of endpoint orientation.

obligations.name: Domain
obligations.constructed_input: Cauchy-Goursat on the actual rectangle between mixed-coordinate corners and exact adjacent integral identities give wedge_difference at every triple of original points.
obligations.justification: Cauchy-Goursat on the actual rectangle between mixed-coordinate corners and exact adjacent integral identities give wedge_difference at every triple of original points.

obligations.name: Coefficients
obligations.required_input: Keep the correct complex contour factors.
obligations.constructed_input: Horizontal integrals and imaginary-unit times vertical integrals retain the original wedge definition. The global/local primitive join is an exact equality, not a path homotopy assumption.
obligations.justification: Horizontal integrals and imaginary-unit times vertical integrals retain the original wedge definition. The global/local primitive join is an exact equality, not a path homotopy assumption.

obligations.name: Local conditions
obligations.required_input: Construct the derivative of the same global primitive.
obligations.constructed_input: At every original point an actual contained disk supplies the pinned local wedge derivative. Global wedge_difference identifies the global primitive locally with that local primitive plus its original constant, yielding derivative f.
obligations.justification: At every original point an actual contained disk supplies the pinned local wedge derivative. Global wedge_difference identifies the global primitive locally with that local primitive plus its original constant, yielding derivative f.

obligations.name: Transition maps
obligations.required_input: Construct boundary extension through genuine uniform completion.
obligations.constructed_input: The original subtype embeds uniformly and densely in its closure. Uniformly continuous complex-valued functions extend through completeness of the complex target, with exact agreement on the original domain.
obligations.justification: The original subtype embeds uniformly and densely in its closure. Uniformly continuous complex-valued functions extend through completeness of the complex target, with exact agreement on the original domain.

obligations.name: Identity
obligations.required_input: Derive bounded primitive extension without pre-assumed boundary values.
obligations.constructed_input: For a bounded holomorphic f, the constructed primitive has bounded derivative. Convex mean value gives its Lipschitz bound, then the uniform extension produces continuous values on the whole closure.
obligations.justification: For a bounded holomorphic f, the constructed primitive has bounded derivative. Convex mean value gives its Lipschitz bound, then the uniform extension produces continuous values on the whole closure.

obligations.name: Consumers
obligations.required_input: Separate primitive extension from holomorphic extension of f.
obligations.constructed_input: No Riemann port, conformal boundary value, vanishing-jump hypothesis, compact P1 or algebraization is used. Matching upper/lower primitive traces and differentiating their glued extension remain subsequent analytic work.
obligations.justification: No Riemann port, conformal boundary value, vanishing-jump hypothesis, compact P1 or algebraization is used. Matching upper/lower primitive traces and differentiating their glued extension remain subsequent analytic work.

obligations.name: Validation
obligations.required_input: Use pinned public analytic/topological APIs and independent review.
obligations.constructed_input: The proof extends the pinned HasPrimitives wedge method to rectangles and uses pinned MeanValue and UniformEmbedding completion. No local Lean build, new axiom, assumed primitive or empirical limit is introduced.
obligations.justification: The proof extends the pinned HasPrimitives wedge method to rectangles and uses pinned MeanValue and UniformEmbedding completion. No local Lean build, new axiom, assumed primitive or empirical limit is introduced.
